R.meaning: reference (frozen L3 identity) evaluated by replay of the capture of C; reference-only requests executed once, recorded separately

options.A: within-project: unseen documents of the 10 exploration projects (existing Round 2 permission; templates exposed; cannot close M2)
options.B: fresh projects 22936, 19905, 20561, 16385, 29255, 24752 (alternates 25883, 19199, 28328, 26214); requires a new owner permission

cohort.sealed: excluded unless separately released by the owner for this exact run

run_set.uses: frozen-label truth presence only; never a prediction or candidate output

selection.freeze: selection, labels, run-set manifest and replacement log hashed after replacements, before either arm runs

labels.review: independent of the drafter; owner-delegated AI review only if stated; human sign-off pending
labels.post_run: no change; disputes in an immutable note that cannot change scores

evaluators.scorer: to be built and independently reviewed in the preparation package (v4 eligibility contract, per-run policy binding)

thresholds_verbatim.text: Target zero observed errors among adjudicated automatically accepted critical facts, with at least 90% correct automatic recovery on clear applicable facts in the expanded M2 evaluation. Preserve the existing 98% minimum accepted-precision gate for other evaluated fields.
Completion additionally requires measured benefit from the selected AI profile, no unresolved critical false acceptance, correct automatic recovery and explicit cost/latency/review burden.

text: an ROI arm's consultant-decision coverage (completed read or verified absence, **including decisions outside the title block**) must be ≥ the matching WP arm's. Unknown (`located_incomplete`) is not coverage.
≥ 1 correctly associated fact per 8 extra requests at equal caps, no new false accept, interval excluding zero

analysis.estimate: paired difference of clean correctly associated recovery (0/1 per document and field)
analysis.request_normalized_benefit: (net correct facts C-B) / (requests C-B) with bootstrap interval; >= 1/8 and interval excluding zero; the request difference is part of the policy
analysis.decision_coverage_gate: C completed reads + verified absences (truth has no decision) >= B; wrong absences never count
analysis.concentration_rule: no default if > 50% of the net gain of C in a field comes from one project or one layout stratum, or matched population < 12

primary_outcomes: false or cross-page association count (.10, per fact): C vs B and C vs R
clean revision recovery lost or gained under PA: C vs R on identical responses
consultant decision under DR: completed reads, verified absences, wrong absences, accepted decisions (correct / wrong), held conflicts: C vs B and C vs R
critical acceptances on resolved and on unresolved truth: each arm
new requests and tokens (actual and estimated) used by DR and by the combined candidate

stochastic_control.design: each identical prompt / image fingerprint executed once; B first, C from the database of B (shared requests inherited); C live once with full capture; R by replay of the capture of C, R-only requests live once as reference-only; seeded 15% variation probe of the fingerprints of C re-executed once, reported only
stochastic_control.not_claimed: independent single reads never isolate a policy effect; B vs C rests on one realization of the reads of C

accounting: application-visible requests per arm and class

limits.semantics: estimates before dispatch; an actual overshoot opens the breaker for later requests; no hard actual-token bound for the CLI

stop_rules: critical acceptance on a resolved label in C: terminal stop, never resumed
three consecutive provider failures: terminal stop
breaker / ledger / allowance / counter refusal: budget stop, never raised
binding difference or second writer: refused before dispatch
